pull.title: KAFKA-21376: Move fetchOrWaitForLeader to clients test fixtures and remove ClusterInstance#getLeaderBrokerId
pull.body:
Ref : https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/KAFKA-21376

Move AdminUtils#fetchOrWaitForLeader from test-common-runtime to AdminClientTestUtils in the clients test fixtures. Add an overload that takes a TopicPartition and waits for the default timeout.

Also fix a race in LeaderElectionCommandTest#assertLeader:
fetchOrWaitForLeader returns the current leader, which can be stale right after an election or shutdown. The helper now waits until the expected broker is the leader.
